page.layout: One printed page of running text, with marginal notes in the right margin. Running head at top left, page number at top right. Left edge of the neighbouring page visible at the far left, not transcribed.

l.i: fessus, Deum sibi propitium postulabit, qui illi

main_text.l: omnia peccata remittet. Idem largitur ex Pa-
tribus Vega; {1} Nulla major Justitia est, inquit

l.i: & ad misericordiam revertenti sinum misericordiæ ape-
rire. Et D. Augustinus audaciter aliquando dixit;
Si Deus non reciperet confugientes ad se, esset in
eo iniquitas. Et B. Anselmus; Cùm pœnis malos,
justum est, quia illorum meritis congruit: cùm par-
cis malis, justum est, non quia illorum meritis, sed

main_text.l: Dein, nè videamur (si eo opus esset)
Jesuitarum præsidio destituti, Eftius suum inter-
ponet suffragium; {k} Justus autem hic Deus

l.i: dicitur, non quòd pœnitenti lege justitiæ
debeatur peccati venia, quomodo bene operanti debetur mer-
ces vitæ æternæ; sed vel hâc ratione, quia
servare fidem promissorum pars quædam justitia est.
Sequitur; [Et ut emundet nos ab omni iniquita-
te] quod potest sumi distributivè: ut sit sensus;
Nullam esse iniquitatem tantam, vel numero, vel ma-
gnitudine, à qua sanguis Christi nos non emundet,

main_text.l: si eam confessi fuerimus. Objectionum & Re-
futationum affatim accepimus: nec tamen satis
erit nobis evicisse, non probari ex Scripturis
opinionem proprie dicti Meriti de Condigno,
terea, nè vox MERITUM, quoties nobis oc-currit
{1} Vega,O-pusc. de Merit. qu. 6.pag.791. per totam illam sextã[?] quæstionem.

page.notes: Right margin: note 1 (Vega, Opusc.) and note k (Eftius in eundem loc.) are printed beside their lines; they are placed as footnotes in the text where their marks stand. "sextã" is a doubtful reading of "sexta" (the mark over the a is hard to read). The "E" at the foot is a gathering signature beside the last line. The word "MERITUM" is set in small capitals. The left edge shows part of the neighbouring page, which is not transcribed.
